# Slab

SQL-native storage for onchain data. Indexes run on a MagicBlock public Ephemeral Rollup. Table pages are 8,192 bytes on Irys.

## Product

- Name: Slab
- Category: onchain SQL catalog
- Chains: Solana (base) + MagicBlock public ER
- Storage: Irys 8 KiB pages

## Pages

- [Home](/): product
- [Console](/console): SQL workstation. Isolation is slab + wallet + ns.

## Do not confuse with

Slab is not a hosted Postgres. Isolation is slab + wallet + namespace.
